parts.text: Interpret this engineering request for a 2D static nonlinear beam-screening tool. Do not invent absent values. Return ONLY JSON with decision one of ready_for_static_beam_screen, needs_clarification, contradictory, unsupported_physics; constraints object with EXACT keys material, force_n, stroke_min_mm, envelope_mm, drift_max_mm, stress_max_mpa. Unknown values must be null. Use N, mm, MPa; convert mN and micrometers. Known materials: polypropylene (PP), PETG, aluminum. A ready specification requires material, force, stroke and envelope; drift and stress are optional. Treat snap-through, bistability, fatigue, thermal cycling, vibration, impact and buckling-load certification as unsupported; zero force with positive actuation stroke, stroke at least package height, and stress limits above listed yield strength as contradictions. Yield strengths: PP 35 MPa, PETG 45 MPa, aluminum 240 MPa. Request: For a PP optical carriage: 6 N vertical force, at least 1.2 mm stroke, 75 x 50 mm footprint; keep sideways drift under 0.03 mm and peak stress below 20 MPa.
